boundary: Independent QA of actual handlers and a conditional Netlify Blobs protocol double; all physical networking denied. Does not establish vendor setup, delivery, customer communications or publication.

checks.name: All authenticated owners can discover both lead platforms without a fabricated connected state
Connection changes require the current owner session and same-site origin
Unsupported sources and malformed business identities cannot create configuration
Preparing Angi retains setup details and exposes an opaque tenant-bound endpoint without claiming vendor setup
Anonymous reads never expose the lead-source secret
Documented Angi input becomes one durable source-aware Inbox request with complete useful context
Optional Angi pro ID can be absent, but a provided different pro ID is rejected
Concurrent retries and a changed redelivery preserve the same saved request and original facts
Two leads about the same service request remain two distinct requests
A copied secret cannot authenticate another workspace or an altered generation
Only the documented x-api-key header authenticates managed Angi intake
Malformed JSON, nonobjects and invalid identifiers are rejected before durable receipt
Rotation revokes the old endpoint but does not duplicate a previously saved lead
Disconnect stops new receipts while preserving readable saved requests
Generation conflicts preserve the current configuration instead of rotating twice
Closed workspaces reject new source configuration and incoming leads without erasing history
A replacement workspace cannot inherit the former endpoint, configuration or lead history
A failed conditional configuration write cannot be reported saved
A lost configuration acknowledgment is recovered by reading the one saved configuration
A failed lead write is never acknowledged without a retained source receipt
A lost lead-write acknowledgment reconciles to one request on vendor retry
A connection read failure returns unavailable rather than inventing a blank setup
Thumbtack preserves an honest partner-access request without a fabricated receiving endpoint
Imported numbers and consent-looking fields never create messaging authority, sends or legacy chase jobs
